sender.hr: „Dijete“, prijatelj ili rođak s novog broja ili s preuzetog računa
sender.en: A “child”, friend or relative on a new number or a hijacked account

name.hr: „Bok mama, ovo mi je novi broj“: hitno posudi novac
name.en: “Hi mum, this is my new number”: lend me money urgently

how.hr: Stiže poruka od „djeteta“ kojem se pokvario ili izgubio mobitel, pa piše s novog broja. Ili poznata osoba, s računa koji je netko preuzeo, moli da joj posudite novac do sutra. Ubrzo slijedi IBAN tuđe osobe i molba da se uplati odmah. Ne može razgovarati, samo pisati. Ponekad stiže i glasovna poruka s glasom stvorenim umjetnom inteligencijom.
how.en: A message arrives from a “child” whose phone broke or got lost, so they are writing from a new number. Or someone you know, from an account someone has taken over, asks to borrow money until tomorrow. Soon comes someone else’s IBAN and a request to pay right away. They can’t talk, only text. Sometimes a voice message with an AI-made voice arrives too.

text.hr: Poruka s nepoznatog broja: „Bok mama/tata, ovo je moj novi broj“.
text.en: A message from an unknown number: “Hi mum/dad, this is my new number”.

text.hr: Hitno treba novac za račun ili posudbu.
text.en: They urgently need money for a bill or a loan.
They send an IBAN that isn’t theirs.

text.hr: Bok mama, razbio mi se mob pa pišem s ovog broja, spremi ga. Imam problem, moram danas platiti račun za stan a ne mogu u bankarstvo na novom mobu. Možeš uplatiti 640 € na ovaj IBAN, vratim ti u ponedjeljak? Ne mogu sad pričati, piši tu
text.en: Hi mum, my phone broke so I’m writing from this number, save it. I have a problem, I have to pay the rent bill today and I can’t get into banking on the new phone. Can you pay 640 € to this IBAN, I’ll pay you back on Monday? Can’t talk now, text here

en: phone broke writing from a new number
child asking for payment to someone else's iban
friend asked to borrow money on whatsapp

hr: Novi broj i hitna molba za novac u istoj poruci.
Izbjegava poziv ili ne može razgovarati.
Glas u poruci može biti umjetno stvoren.
en: A new number and an urgent money request in the same message.
The IBAN is in someone else’s name.
They avoid calls or can’t talk.
The voice in a message can be AI-made.

hr: Ne plaćajte. Nazovite osobu na njezin stari, poznati broj.
Postavite pitanje na koje samo ona zna odgovor ili dogovorite obiteljsku lozinku.
Ako ste platili, odmah nazovite banku i prijavite policiji.
en: Don’t pay. Call the person on their old, known number.
Ask something only they would know, or agree a family password.
If you paid, call your bank at once and report it to the police.
